# Therapy notes

Private. Dr. Rachel Notrealsson, PsyD, telehealth Tuesdays 08:00, every other week.
$180/session, out of network; Example Health reimburses 60% after the deductible.
Started 2025-10 after the burnout last fall.

## Themes
- Burnout from running the business alone; saying yes to every client
- Sleep: wake at 3 a.m. thinking about deadlines (Spokane cutover now)
- Dad's death in 2021; I still haven't sorted his things in the storage unit
- Money anxiety even though the numbers are fine. Rachel calls it "scarcity script"
- Priya and the second-child question; I feel I'd be choosing between her and the business

## Session notes
**2026-09-29.** Talked about Amsterdam: first trip in years where I didn't
check email for whole days. Rachel asked what made that possible. Answer:
Dana covering Atlas. Homework: list three things only I can do at work and
hand off the rest.

**2026-10-13.** Raymond Fakesworth's job offer (see [[Acme job offer]]). I
noticed relief when I imagined taking it, then guilt. Rachel: relief is data.
Sertraline is helping; no side effects except vivid dreams.

**2026-10-27.** Sleep worse with Spokane slipping. Agreed I'd ask Acme for
a change order if the date moves, instead of absorbing it. Breathing exercise
4-7-8 before bed. Next: 2026-11-10.
